relationships.subject: fia
relationships.context: everyone in the paddock, pit lane or track must wear one; issued only with FIA agreement and used only by its holder

relationships.subject: operational personnel
relationships.context: max 60 per Competitor from 29 h before FP1 to 2 h after the Race start; unlimited from 45 min before the formation lap to 15 min after the Race start

relationships.subject: trainee personnel
relationships.context: 16 individual exceptions per Competitor per Championship on top of the 60; each trainee max three Competitions

relationships.subject: competitor
relationships.context: submitted before Restricted Period One; later changes at the FIA's discretion; exempt staff listed before the end of the Competition

relationships.subject: personnel declaration
relationships.context: uses the FIA's official template

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: operational and trainee personnel may not be within the circuit

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: 42 h to 29 h before FP1

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: 18 h to 4 h before FP1

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: SFC: 14 h to 3 h before FP3, starting earlier if the gap after FP2 exceeds 4 h

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: AFC: 14 h to 3 h before the Sprint formation lap, starting earlier if the gap after Sprint Qualifying exceeds 3 h

relationships.subject: restricted period three
relationships.context: SFC

relationships.subject: restricted period three
relationships.context: AFC

relationships.subject: restricted period breach
relationships.context: staff may enter the paddock 30 min before a period ends and stay 1 h (RP1/RP2) or 30 min (RP3) after it starts for exercise, meals and socialising; any operational work then is a breach

relationships.subject: restricted period breach
relationships.context: both drivers start the Race from the pit lane

relationships.subject: restricted period one
relationships.context: six exceptions per Competitor per Championship, not used consecutively in one Competition

relationships.subject: restricted period two
relationships.context: five exceptions per Competitor per Championship, not used consecutively in one Competition

relationships.subject: restricted period three
relationships.context: four exceptions per Competitor per Championship, not used consecutively in one Competition

relationships.subject: non-operational personnel
relationships.context: exempt; may load or unload freight, prepare equipment for other series and prepare garage displays

relationships.subject: restricted period
relationships.context: warning boards placed before the turnstiles

relationships.subject: race director
relationships.context: may grant all Competitors an extra exception (not counted) if an official supplier fails to deliver, no later than 12 h before it starts
